    • getLocation

      public @Nullable String getLocation()
      Specifies the location of the regional secrets used to create a SecretManagerServiceClient specific to the location endpoint. If not provided, the client will be created using the global endpoint. It must be one of the available location for the regional endpoints. See Secret Manager locations for more information.
      Returns:
      Location of the regional secrets
